THE JAPAN THAT CAN SAY NO

On this page is a copy of an English translation of the (in)famous
"The Japan That Can Say No: The New U.S.-Japan Relations Card" by
Akio Morita and Shintaro Ishihara. The book was written in 1989
and published by Kobunsha Publishing Ltd. Included are some articles 
written in the early 1990s in response to the article.
